About The Role

As a ServiceNow Sr. Technical Consultant, you will make an impact by translating business requirements into scalable ServiceNow solutions that improve workflows, integrations and user experiences. You will work collaboratively with business stakeholders, project leaders and technical teams to design, deliver and support high-quality platform capabilities.

In This Role, You Will

  • Analyze business and system requirements, identify dependencies and translate needs into effective ServiceNow solution designs.
  • Design, develop, test, implement, maintain and support ServiceNow applications, modules and custom-scoped solutions.
  • Build and enhance integrations using REST APIs, LDAP, Active Directory, JDBC, Orchestration and IntegrationHub.
  • Create and review technical specifications, workflows, test results and documentation; identify and complete corrective actions.
  • Resolve complex technical issues independently, recommend reusable solutions and help coordinate assigned project activities to support on-time, high-quality delivery.

Work model

We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants in Canada. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

What you need to have to be considered

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Business or a related field and 3–5 years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Hands-on JavaScript development experience on the ServiceNow platform, including custom-scoped applications.
  • Experience building ServiceNow integrations using REST APIs, LDAP, Active Directory, JDBC, Orchestration or IntegrationHub.
  • Experience with Service Portal, UI Builder, Configurable Workspace, Now Experience Framework, Flow Designer and Automated Test Framework.
  • Strong consulting, communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams, deliver quality work on schedule and support occasional non-standard shifts or on-call coverage.

These will help you stand out

  • Knowledge of ServiceNow Governance, Risk and Compliance or Integrated Risk Management, with related certification.
  • Experience with ServiceNow IT Service Management, IT Operations Management or Security Operations.
  • ServiceNow Certified Application Developer certification.
  • ITIL Foundation certification.
  • Experience leading assigned workstreams, coordinating tasks and monitoring delivery performance.

We’re excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don’t hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

Applicants will be accepted till 11/20/2026

The annual salary for this position will be in the range of $92,000 - $102,000 CAD depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the architecture, design and implementation of enterprise ServiceNow CMDB solutions aligned to CSDM and configuration management objectives.
  • Partner with platform, infrastructure, application, service management, security, operations and business stakeholders to define configuration data requirements, ownership and measurable outcomes.
  • Define architectures covering CI class models, service and application models, relationships, lifecycle states, ownership, data sources and supporting governance workflows.
  • Design traceable and reusable relationships between business applications, application services, technical services, infrastructure components, locations, users and support groups.
  • Develop and maintain architectural views, CSDM-aligned data models, integration designs, decision records, configuration standards and detailed technical specifications.
  • Promote configuration-first, upgrade-safe use of out-of-the-box ServiceNow CMDB capabilities and challenge unnecessary customization.
  • Provide technical leadership to delivery teams and review configurations, extensions and code for security, quality, performance and maintainability.
  • Architect integrations and ingestion patterns using Discovery, Service Mapping, Service Graph Connectors, IntegrationHub ETL, APIs and other appropriate technologies.
  • Define Identification and Reconciliation Engine rules, source precedence, reconciliation controls and multi-source data patterns to prevent duplicates and protect authoritative data.
  • Establish CMDB health, certification, attestation, remediation and lifecycle-management practices that improve completeness, correctness, compliance and currency.
  • Ensure security, privacy, data ownership, access controls, auditability and segregation of duties are embedded within solution designs.
  • Support projects through architecture review, design assurance, testing, deployment and mandatory governance processes.
  • Troubleshoot complex CMDB, discovery, service mapping and integration issues and guide teams towards sustainable resolutions.
  • Shape the ServiceNow CMDB and CSDM roadmap, standards and reusable patterns, remaining current with product releases and recognized configuration management practices.
  • Mentor architects, CMDB administrators, data owners and delivery colleagues and contribute to continuous improvement across the ServiceNow architecture practice.

Important: This is an architecture role specializing in ServiceNow CMDB and CSDM; it is not a lead developer role. A deep technical understanding of the platform, Configuration Management Database data model, Identification and Reconciliation Engine and configuration data lifecycle is required, but the candidate should expect to spend most of their time working with project teams, data owners and business stakeholders, shaping CMDB solutions, producing design documentation, making architectural decisions and supporting projects through mandatory governance processes. Hands-on development will normally be limited to occasional proof-of-concept, configuration validation or technical analysis work.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Certified ServiceNow Administrator (CSA)
  • Certified Implementation Specialist – Data Foundations (CMDB and CSDM) (CIS-DF), or the current equivalent ServiceNow certification.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, interpersonal and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex CMDB, CSDM, data governance and technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • 5+ years of ServiceNow experience in solution or technical architecture roles, including substantial hands-on architecture experience with enterprise CMDB implementations.
  • A proven track record of leading end-to-end ServiceNow CMDB solution designs and delivering complex, enterprise-scale implementations.
  • Deep knowledge of the ServiceNow CMDB and CSDM, including CI class hierarchy, service and application modelling, relationships, lifecycle states, ownership and CSDM domains.
  • Experience designing CMDB governance frameworks, operating models, data ownership, certification, attestation, remediation and continuous improvement processes.
  • Strong knowledge of CMDB Health, Data Manager, CI Class Manager, duplicate management, stale CI handling and the completeness, correctness and compliance health measures.
  • Strong understanding of ServiceNow platform architecture, data model, security model, workspaces, reporting, workflow automation and upgrade-safe design practices.
  • Experience populating and maintaining the CMDB through Discovery, Service Mapping, Service Graph Connectors, IntegrationHub ETL, APIs, import sets and other appropriate ingestion technologies.
  • Deep understanding of Identification and Reconciliation Engine configuration, identification rules, reconciliation rules, data source rules, source precedence and multi-source CMDB patterns.
  • Experience integrating CMDB data with ITSM, ITOM, Security Operations, Asset Management and other platform capabilities to support impact, change, incident and service-management outcomes.
  • Working knowledge of ServiceNow scripting, including JavaScript and GlideRecord, sufficient to assess technical feasibility and assure solution quality.
  • Experience working with Agile and Waterfall delivery approaches and participating across the full software development lifecycle.
  • Solid understanding of ITIL configuration management, architecture governance, data security and privacy, change and release management, testing and audit requirements.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams, with strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Excellent Microsoft Word, Excel, Visio and PowerPoint skills.

Beneficial:

We are looking for a hands-on ServiceNow Developer to join our IT Platform team. This person will own the day-to-day configuration, development, and support of our ServiceNow instance, working across ITSM & HRSD while helping extend the platform through custom development and third-party integrations. This is a highly technical, delivery-focused role for someone who enjoys building, troubleshooting, and continuously improving a mission-critical enterprise platform.

You'll work across our development, staging, and production instances, partner closely with IT and business stakeholders, and help drive our upgrade and enhancement roadmap forward.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Build integrations: Design, develop, and troubleshoot integrations between ServiceNow and third-party systems using REST/SOAP APIs, OAuth, webhooks, Integration Hub, MCP, and iPaaS platforms such as Workato.
  • Maintain and optimize the platform: Monitor platform health, troubleshoot performance issues, optimize scripts and flows, and ensure solutions remain scalable and maintainable.
  • Support ServiceNow applications like ITSM & HRSD: Help deliver and improve Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and HR-related workflows and automations.
  • Manage access and security: Administer roles, ACLs, permissions, and other platform access controls in line with security and audit requirements.
  • Resolve complex issues: Act as an escalation point for platform-level incidents, perform root cause analysis, and coordinate with infrastructure, security, vendors, and other technical teams when issues span multiple systems.
  • Deliver enhancements and projects: Partner with stakeholders to gather requirements, prioritize the backlog, design solutions, and take work through development, testing, deployment, and post-launch support.
  • Drive platform consistency: Establish reusable development patterns and standards for workflows, notifications, approvals, documentation, and user experiences.
  • Support upgrades and releases: Evaluate new ServiceNow releases, test upgrades, remediate breaking changes, and adopt relevant new platform capabilities.
  • Document and enable: Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, integration documentation, and user procedures, and provide support or training when needed.

What You Need To Bring

  • Hands-on experience developing and administering ServiceNow, ideally across ITSM and/or HRSD.
  • Strong JavaScript skills, including ServiceNow scripting APIs such as GlideRecord and GlideAjax.
  • Experience with Flow Designer, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs, and Service Catalog development.
  • Experience designing and troubleshooting REST/SOAP integrations, OAuth, webhooks, and enterprise integrations.
  • Strong understanding of ITSM processes and how they translate into ServiceNow solutions.
  • Ability to independently troubleshoot complex issues across ServiceNow and connected systems.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Experience working with stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to have's

  • Experience with HRSD, ITOM, Workday, or identity/HR platforms.
  • Experience with ServiceNow AI/GenAI capabilities, including Now Assist.
  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and MCP-enabled tools or workflows.
  • Experience with Service Portal, custom widgets, HTML, and CSS.
  • Experience with Workato or other iPaaS platforms.
  • ServiceNow CSA or CAD, or ITIL 4 Foundation certification.

Be a changemaker

You’ll Enjoy

  • A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work
  • A culture that celebrates performance
  • The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard
  • Career-defining opportunities

Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled.

  • Flexible paid time off and remote work policies
  • Equity options, because this is your company too
  • Contributions to your pension plan. Your future matters
  • Training opportunities to grow your skills and career
  • Health and wellness credit so you feel your best

  • Interest groups, employee led networks, social committees to sponsored sports teams

Our Salesforce org is the system of record for how Docebo sells, renews and serves customers. The team that runs it is small, senior, and split between Canada and Italy. We're adding a senior developer to carry that forward.
